title: 39 medals, top-five finish: India ends CWG 2026 with several historic firsts
content: With several medal-rich sports missing from the programme because of financial constraints in hosting the Games — after the event was moved from Victoria in Australia to Glasgow — expectations were lower than in previous editions. Even so, India found success in new events, celebrated new athletes and produced several landmark performances.

title: Inside India's broken jobs market and why the 'cockroaches' are fed up
content: India's expanding higher education system produces millions of graduates annually.  However, quality job creation has not kept pace with this educational growth.  Many educated youth struggle to find stable, well-paying employment opportunities.  This mismatch fuels widespread frustration and youth-led protests across the nation.  The situation highlights a critical challenge for India's demographic dividend.

title: SC warns Punjab for ignoring 15-yr-old ruling on dues to Himachal Pradesh
content: The Supreme Court criticized Punjab for its resistance to implementing an old decree.  Attorney General Venkataramani proposed a cashless settlement for power dues.  Himachal and Haryana agreed to the proposal, while Punjab raised objections.  The court warned Punjab of consequences if it fails to comply.  A final decision is expected on August 12.

title: Jeff Bezos warns Mamdani on NYC taxes, slams wasteful spending
content: Jeff Bezos commented on New York City's proposed pied-à-terre tax. He suggested that aggressive tax increases could negatively impact tourism and competitiveness. Bezos also criticized targeting individuals, calling it a villain strategy. He argued that government spending inefficiencies are a greater concern than taxation. Bezos previously criticized the city's public school spending and economic policies.

title: 'Counting fingers, not hearts': Shehzad Poonawalla mocks Rahul's Gen Z post
content: Shehzad Poonawalla criticised Rahul Gandhi's recent social media post. He interpreted Gandhi's gesture as counting corruption and bribes daily. Poonawalla accused the Gandhi family of extensive involvement in corruption. Rahul Gandhi had shared a Korean finger heart gesture on Friendship Day. This outreach aimed to connect with younger audiences on social media.

title: Nuclear plants, Gaza craters: Google pulls AI tool from Google Earth in 24 hours
content: Google has removed its new AI image generation feature from Google Earth. This action followed immediate concerns raised by researchers about disinformation risks. Experts warned the tool could easily create convincing fake satellite imagery for public deception. Google stated they are implementing stronger safeguards while pausing the feature. The company noted generated images were watermarked as AI-created.

title: Rape victim forced to lick sputum by panchayat in Bihar; FIR filed
content: A woman was forced to lick sputum by a village panchayat in Begusarai.  She had alleged rape by a co-villager on multiple occasions.  The local council instead accused her of an illicit relationship.  An FIR was lodged after a video of the incident went viral.  Police are investigating the video and searching for the rape accused.

title: Michigan woman sues Toll Brothers over access to her 19-acre property
content: A woman from Michigan has initiated legal action against Toll Brothers concerning their wastewater management and access rights. Her property, undeveloped, is situated between two upcoming luxury housing estates. The lawsuit alleges that the developers have disregarded her property rights and neglected environmental regulations. She aims to reinstate her access easement and challenge the site plan approvals.

title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day leaked on X, reaches 5.9M accounts before removal
content: A high-quality bootleg of Spider-Man: Brand New Day ran on X for around seven hours on Friday, reaching 5.9 million accounts and drawing over 143,000 likes before Sony had it pulled. It follows a full leak of Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey eight days earlier. Neither dented the numbers: Tom Holland's Spider-Man took roughly $168 million on opening day, beating Avengers: Endgame's 2019 record.

title: Nanaji Deshmukh Awas Yojana: How workers can avail Rs 1.6 lakh housing aid
content: In Gujarat, registered construction workers have the opportunity to benefit from financial support aimed at housing through the Shree Nanaji Deshmukh Awas Yojana. To qualify, applicants must have been registered with the welfare board for a minimum of two years. Following the acquisition of an e-Nirman Card and house allotment, they can submit their applications. Those approved will receive ₹1.6 lakh to assist in home ownership.

title: Deshaun Watson throws six INTs in training camp amid QB battle with Shedeur Sanders
content: In the competition for the Cleveland Browns' quarterback position, Shedeur Sanders is reportedly taking the lead, demonstrating superior performance metrics compared to Deshaun Watson in early practice sessions. Watson has been hindered by interception issues during camp. However, wide receiver Jerry Jeudy appears to support Watson as the preferred starter. The coaching staff will have the final say in this pivotal decision.

title: Lamine Yamal's family struggles shaped his inspiring World Cup journey
content: Lamine Yamal's rise to winning the 2026 FIFA World Cup is inseparable from the story of the family that built him. His mother Sheila Ebana was 16 when she gave birth to him. His father Mounir, a Moroccan immigrant, worked construction and street jobs to stay afloat. His grandmother Fátima crossed from Morocco to Spain alone, undocumented, and worked three jobs to bring her children over. His father survived a life-threatening stabbing in August 2024. Yamal's name itself honours two strangers who helped his parents financially before he was born. This is the full human story behind the boy who hugged his little brother on a World Cup pitch in New Jersey.

title: Brittany Mahomes shares powerful message on motherhood after Patrick's success
content: Kansas City Chiefs star Patrick Mahomes' wife, Brittany Mahomes, shared a heartfelt message about motherhood, leadership and the next generation while celebrating another major milestone beyond football. The Kansas City Current co-owner reflected on why she wants her children to see women in leadership as the norm after helping build one of the biggest success stories in women's sports. Here's what Brittany said during her speech, why she was honored, Patrick Mahomes' loving reaction, and how her impact continues to shape opportunities for women on and off the field

title: Why Aaron Rodgers is CBS’s top choice to replace Tony Romo as analyst

title: Ramlila body asks 'Ramayana' makers to hold special screening before release

title: 'CJP stands with students': Abhijeet Dipke backs Jharkhand protest

Protesters have lost faith in the current CID investigation into the matter. They seek reforms in the recruitment process and action against responsible officials. The students warn of further escalation if their concerns are not addressed.

title: Delhi lawyer in London reveals why she won’t return to India's corporate
content: Jasleen Kaur, a solicitor now thriving in London, has no plans to return to India for her corporate career. She appreciates the UK’s balanced approach to work-life integration, where employers honor personal time and work hours. This lifestyle allows her to explore her hobbies and nurture personal growth, starkly contrasting with the higher demands and lesser regard for employee welfare found in Indian corporate settings.

title: Locked, loaded ... and put on hold: Another bewildering Trump pivot on Iran

Meanwhile, domestic political challenges and internal party criticism are growing for the President.  Markets and allies closely watch these developments and policy shifts.

title: India's deep-sea bet: Centre's 'Samudra Manthan' to churn crude — How it works
content: India is funding half the cost of deepwater oil and gas exploration wells. This new scheme aims to reduce reliance on imported energy supplies. The government will support sixty exploration wells over the next five years. This initiative encourages companies to explore previously avoided offshore areas. Shared infrastructure will also lower development costs for new discoveries.

title: Bullion market: What will guide gold, silver prices this week?

Purchasing managers' index data from major economies will also be closely monitored. Developments concerning the US-Iran conflict and crude oil supplies will influence sentiment. Analysts anticipate gold to trade between Rs 1.40-1.44 lakh per 10 grams.

title: New York's pied-à-terre tax has homeowners trying to dodge it. Here's why
content: Homeowners in New York City received alerts about the implementation of a new pied-à-terre tax. This tax requires individuals to demonstrate that their properties serve as primary residences to sidestep the added charge. It specifically affects high-value homes not utilized as the owner's primary dwelling. In response, many homeowners are gathering necessary documentation and engaging experts to help with the exemption application process.

title: 'Job loss, financial stress': Pune family of 3 dies by 'suicide'; note found

Investigations are ongoing, and bodies have been sent for post-mortem.

title: Is there a genetic 'silver spoon'? What your genes can, and can't, tell you
content: Genetics play a pivotal role in determining the predisposition to certain diseases, but they don't seal our fate. Factors such as lifestyle choices and environmental context heavily impact our overall health and life paths. A recent study on twins underscores the strong correlation between genetics and intelligence, as well as socioeconomic achievement, prompting a reevaluation of how we perceive privilege.

title: 'Kerala stands united': Rahul condoles rain deaths, urges Congress workers to help
content: he offers condolences to families of eight people who have lost their lives . he urges party workers to assist in relief and recovery operations . the state government is making every possible effort to support affected families . "i stand firmly with every single person in this difficult hour," he says .

title: 'Cancel JPSC exam': Jharkhand students continue protest, seek CBI investigation
content: students continue their protest in Ranchi for the fifth consecutive day . they are seeking a CBI probe into recruitment examinations, cancellation of the 14th JPSC Combined Preliminary Test and reforms in the state’s recruitment agencies . protestors threaten to march to the assembly if the state government does not address their demands .
